segments.name: Travel
segments.description: Travel booking and commerce operations serving leisure, luxury, cruise, group and business travelers through proprietary booking platforms and concierge support.
segments.evidence: Our Travel segment provides travelers with a full range of travel services through our NXT2.0 booking engine, which offers extensive inventory and a platform for curating personalized experiences and efficient trip planning and booking.

segments.name: Media
segments.description: Content creation, audience development, media distribution and advertising monetization for travel audiences, which also drives demand into the Travel segment.
segments.evidence: Our Media segment consists of JOURNY.tv, a Connected TV Channel broadcast as Free Ad Supported Streaming TV ("FAST") and Advertising Video on Demand ("AVOD") that specializes in travel, adventure, and culture-focused content, and Travel Magazine, an online travel magazine that provides articles, tips, guides, and inspiration for travelers.

revenueModel.text: The Travel segment earns commissions, markups and service fees on travel bookings, while the Media segment earns advertising, sponsorship, branded content and destination marketing revenue.
revenueModel.evidence: The Travel segment generates revenue primarily through commissions, markups, and service fees on travel bookings, as well as advisor-driven commissions and attribution-based fees through Travel Magazine Pro™.

changes.text: In fiscal 2026 the company began reporting two reportable segments, Travel and Media, following acquisitions and expanded business activities.
changes.evidence: As a result of these changes, we updated our internal reporting structure and, beginning in the third quarter of fiscal year 2026, we report our financial performance based on two reportable segments: Travel and Media.

changes.text: In fiscal 2026 the company acquired Five Star Alliance (April 2025) and TA Pipeline (August 2025), expanding its travel operations.
changes.evidence: This change was driven primarily by acquisitions completed during fiscal year 2026, including FSA and TA Pipeline, which expanded our travel-related operations, and JOURNY.tv, which expanded our media operations.

changes.text: In February 2026 the company acquired GoUSA TV content, brand rights and distribution assets from Brand USA and integrated them into JOURNY.tv.
changes.evidence: In February 2026, we acquired original content, brand rights, and distribution assets of GoUSA TV from Brand USA (The Corporation for Travel Promotion).
